title: Sebi proposes to widen foreign investors' access to non-agricultural commodities derivatives - The Economic Times
text:
​India's markets ​regulator on Tuesday proposed ​to widen foreign investors' access to non-agricultural commodity derivatives ‌by allowing ⁠them ⁠to trade in ​physically settled contracts, a proposal paper ​on its website showed.
